result.summary: Analysis identified minor styling and layout inconsistencies affecting icon visibility and spatial harmony.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons utilize thin white outlines that blend into light-colored food imagery.
issues.suggestion: Add a semi-transparent background circle or increase icon stroke weight.

issues.description: Vertical padding between the promotional banner and the 'Fastest near you' section is inconsistent with other gaps.
issues.suggestion: Apply a uniform margin-bottom to all top-level content sections.
